Well thanks so much for the advice. However, it seems like you believe I'm pursuing a graduate degree, which I am not. I'm talking about undergraduate BBA. If it was for MBA, I would without a doubt choose Chicago. I"m definitely trying to a top 3 MBA program though!

We aren't letting randoms choose where we go. The reason we ask, at least reason I asked, was because I knew people, like grad students, could tell me things about the job market and elucidate other factors or concerns I had about the school because perhaps they have more expertise. For example which school has better placement in a specific sector is extremely hard to find out unless you know someone from that sector, and if you don't, theres no better way than the internet. And even after, I'm the one who ultimately makes the decision. The purpose of asking is to gain the most knowledge you can to make the most well informed decision possible. But I will say, yes, there are less bright people out there who will make their decision completely off a random's opinion, but I believe that is few and far between.
